morphology.pattern_note: 按外来专名整体处理，不作马来语词缀分析。Mc- 属于该姓氏的历史构成，不是马来语前缀。IPA 为常见英语读法，具体读音应尊重姓名持有者。

senses.zh_definition: 通常指外来姓氏 McCall，中文常音译为“麦考尔”；具体所指须由上下文确定。
senses.en_definition: Usually the surname McCall; the particular bearer or referent must be identified from context.
senses.ms_definition: Nama keluarga asing yang lazimnya dieja McCall; orang atau rujukan khususnya perlu dikenal pasti melalui konteks.
senses.nuances: 这是专有名词的条件性识别，不是已核实的马来语普通词条。输入没有原文语境，不能排除其他专名所指。保留查询键 mccall，正文通常写 McCall。status 使用 unverified，以免把未核实项目误标为官方词条。以下搭配是示范性姓名用法，没有经语料频率验证。[姓氏资料](https://www.ancestry.com/last-name-meaning/mccall)

etymology.historical_story: McCall belongs to Gaelic surname traditions rather than Malay word formation. The Dictionary of American Family Names identifies Irish and Scottish origins, commonly through Mac Cathail, meaning 'son of Cathal', with another derivation also recorded. Its appearance in Malay text can therefore reflect a named person rather than an adopted everyday word. [Source](https://www.ancestry.com/last-name-meaning/mccall)
